text: Ellen Ripley wakes from 57 years in stasis to find her employers doubt her story of alien eggs on LV-426. When contact with its colony is lost, she returns with Colonial Marines and finds a frightened girl named Newt, the only colonist left, and the rest [cocooned as hosts for alien embryos|rules|it gets inside you]. As the creatures tear through the marines, Ripley learns the company man Burke [sent the colonists to the eggs for profit|wants|wealth and ambition], and she goes down into the hive alone to face [the alien queen among her eggs|threat|monsters and creatures].
